content: Open Food Facts: official v2 JSON API supports product-by-barcode lookup and name search; database licensed ODbL (attribution and share-alike required if redistributing); over 4 million products with Brazilian coverage (GS1 prefixes 789/790) uneven across small regional brands; API etiquette says one API call per real scan; bulk exports available for caching. TACO is a separate NEPA/UNICAMP dataset not available through OFF; community normalization projects exist on GitHub (brolesi/taco REST, raulfdm/taco-api GraphQL).
